requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text:
蜂鸣器（D6）每 3 秒响一次，按钮（D2）暂停/恢复
验收约定：D6使用无源蜂鸣器，音调1000Hz，每次持续100ms；初始运行且静音，累计运行3000ms后首次发声，此后每累计运行3000ms开始一次。D2使用INPUT_PULLUP，低电平按下沿切换暂停/恢复，长按及松开不切换。暂停立即静音，保留计时和剩余鸣叫时长，恢复后继续，不能重新开始完整周期。响应及鸣叫时间容差20ms。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Drive io_2 with delta time steps (starting at 0 for first step) while io_0 remains false until a press edge sets io_0 true (press), optionally press again to resume; vary timing around 3000ms and 100ms boundaries while ensuring long-press and release do not change state except at rising edges.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_1 initial is 0; while running, starting only after accumulated 3000ms of active (non-paused) time, output io_1=1000 for 100ms then 0; repeats every additional 3000ms of accumulated running time with tolerance ±20ms; on io_0 rising edge (pause toggle), io_1 becomes 0 immediately and stays 0 while paused, preserving phase and remaining 100ms burst time; on next io_0 rising edge (resume), io_1 continues with the preserved remaining schedule without restarting the full 3000ms cycle; output must never be active while paused.
